title: 第395章 番外：权臣在现代（一）
slug: 读心后疯批暴君决定洗白
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

（以下为原宋相番外篇，由于两位云初同名，原宋相名字里的云我会用繁体字哦。）

宋雲初迷迷糊糊间，感受到自己的身躯在不断摇晃，晃得她想吐。

耳畔有人在不停地交流，吵闹得很。

“都跟她说别加班了，大不了我养她，就不听，非得加班，得亏了有你这个室友在，否则她一个人在屋里晕倒了都没人知道。”

“大概是因为快年底了吧，她们做策划的肯定有不少工作量，她还是组长，更闲不下来了。”

“唉，其实我劝过她换个工作，可惜她不太愿意出镜，不然跟我一起直播带货多好，应该比现在赚得多。”

宋雲初在睡梦中拧起了眉头。

什么组长，什么直播……边上这两人说的话她竟听不明白。

她现在是到了地府么？

她想看看这阴间的风貌，奈何眼皮沉得睁不开。

从前常听人说作恶太多会不得好死，死后还会下地狱，她的确是不得好死了，被君天逸命人乱箭射死的那一刻，她就在想着，人死后会到一个怎样的世界？

是否像坊间说的那样，会进入轮回？

若是真的有投胎转世，像她这样作恶多端的人，是会继续做人还是做动物？

若是做人的话，她倒真想好好活一次，若是做动物……

她定要在上餐桌之前自尽，死了重来。

身边两人还在喋喋不休。

“幸好这会儿不堵车，师傅能不能再快点儿？”

“快不了姑娘，再快就超速了。”

宋雲初想吐的欲望越发强烈。

这地府的人真是吵闹得很，还净说些让她听不明白的话。

但好在，人死后无需再体验生前的疼痛，那乱箭穿心的感觉她光是回想起来都觉得呼吸困难。

她费力地想要睁眼，忽觉脑内一震，无数记忆碎片如潮水般涌入。

那些记忆，来自于一个和她同名的女子。

她像是一个旁观者，在毫无准备的情况下，就突然获知了另一个人的所有生活轨迹。

她的脑仁仿佛都要炸开了，幸好这种感觉只持续了片刻，脑内很快就平复了下来。

她总算睁开了眼——

她正处于一片狭小的空间内，她的头似乎枕在一个人的腿上，怪不得她会如此难受。

这双腿，细且白，腿的主人穿一双银色带细闪的……高跟鞋，对，是叫这个名字。

鼻翼间有淡淡的馨香萦绕，宋雲初试着动了动身子，将自己与长腿的主人分离。

耳畔顿时响起女子的惊呼声，“卧槽，还没到医院你就醒了？”

“醒了也好，能自己醒过来，说明应该没什么大问题。”另一道女声接过了话，“你没事吧云初？你刚才晕倒在房间里了，我们正要带你去医院检查。”

宋雲初无暇顾及身边的二人，而是低头观察自己此刻的身体。

手脚健全，这是一副年轻的躯体。

(The following is an extra chapter about the former Prime Minister of the Song Dynasty. Since the two Yun Chus have the same name, I will use the traditional Chinese characters for Yun in the name of the original Prime Minister of the Song Dynasty.)

Song Yunchu felt her body shaking in a daze, making her want to vomit.

There were people talking non-stop in my ears, making it very noisy.

"I told her not to work overtime. At worst, I support her, but she won't listen and has to work overtime. Fortunately, you are here as a roommate, otherwise no one would know if she fainted alone in the room."

"Maybe it's because it's almost the end of the year. They must have a lot of workload as planners. She is also the team leader, so she has no time to spare."

"Oh, I actually persuaded her to change her job, but unfortunately she is not willing to appear on the scene. Otherwise, it would be great to live-stream with me to deliver goods. She should make more money than she does now."

Song Yunchu frowned in his sleep.

What team leader, what live broadcast... She couldn't understand what the two people beside her were saying.

Is she in the underworld now?

She wanted to see what the underworld looked like, but her eyelids were too heavy to open.

In the past, I often heard people say that if you do too much evil, you will die a bad death, and you will go to hell after death. She did not die a good death. The moment she was shot to death by random arrows ordered by Jun Tianyi, she was thinking about what kind of world people will go to after death.

Will he enter reincarnation as people say?

If reincarnation is possible, will a person like her who has done many evil things continue to be a human being or an animal?

If she were a human being, she would really want to live a good life. If she were an animal...

She must commit suicide before serving the dinner table and die all over again.

The two people beside him were still chattering.

"Fortunately, there is no traffic jam at the moment. Master, can you hurry up?"

"You can't go faster than a girl, and if you go faster, you're speeding."

Song Yunchu's desire to vomit became stronger and stronger.

The people in this underworld were really noisy, and they always said things that she couldn't understand.

But fortunately, after death, there is no need to experience the pain in life. She felt breathless just thinking about the feeling of arrows piercing her heart.

She tried hard to open her eyes, but suddenly she felt a shock in her head, and countless memory fragments poured in like a tide.

Those memories come from a woman with the same name as her.

She was like a bystander who suddenly learned all the life trajectories of another person without any preparation.

Her brain felt like it was going to explode. Fortunately, this feeling only lasted for a moment, and her brain quickly calmed down.

She finally opened her eyes——

She was in a small space, and her head seemed to be resting on someone's lap. No wonder she felt so uncomfortable.

These legs are thin and white. The owner of the legs wears a pair of silver high heels with thin glitter. Yes, that's the name.

With a faint fragrance lingering between his nose, Song Yunchu tried to move his body to separate himself from the owner of the long legs.

A woman's exclamation suddenly sounded in her ears, "Damn it, you woke up before we even got to the hospital?"

"It's good to be awake. Being able to wake up on your own means there shouldn't be a big problem." Another female voice took over, "Are you okay Yun Chu? You just fainted in the room. We are about to take you to the hospital for examination."

Song Yunchu had no time to pay attention to the two people around him, but lowered his head to observe his body at the moment.

The hands and feet are sound, and this is a young body.
